snippet.title: Rust & Roots | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Rust & Roots now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445360/Rust__Roots/ 

Rust & Roots is a mission-based top-down shooter experience. Fight against hordes of robots in a devastated world, explore a semi-open world and survive action-packed battles. In a dark and realistic atmosphere, become humanity's last hope and resist the machine apocalypse!
